moments.title: Reading & Leeds Festivals ignite for Bank Holiday
moments.blurb: The twin festivals, Reading and Leeds, kick off this Thursday for the August Bank Holiday weekend, featuring headliners Charli XCX, Dave, RAYE, Florence + The Machine, Fontaines D.C., and Chase & Status.

angles.name: Main Festival Buzz
angles.copy: Reading & Leeds is about to explode! Who are you hyped to see this Bank Holiday weekend? The biggest names are set to take over both sites from Thursday. #RandL26

angles.name: Headliner Focus
angles.copy: Florence + The Machine, Charli XCX, Dave, RAYE... the Reading & Leeds line-up is absolutely stacked! Who's bringing the main stage energy for you?

angles.name: Leeds Local Angle
angles.copy: Bramham Park is getting ready! Leeds Festival kicks off this Thursday, bringing massive artists and thousands of you to Yorkshire for the Bank Holiday. Get ready for the noise!

moments.title: Notting Hill Carnival returns for a vibrant Bank Holiday
moments.blurb: Europe's largest street festival, Notting Hill Carnival, will transform West London this Bank Holiday weekend, running from Saturday 29th to Monday 31st August with parades, music, and food.

angles.name: Carnival Countdown
angles.copy: The countdown is on! Notting Hill Carnival is just days away, bringing incredible energy, music, and colour to London for the Bank Holiday weekend. Who's heading down?

angles.name: London Local Buzz
angles.copy: West London is about to come alive! Get ready for the spectacular sights and sounds of Notting Hill Carnival, starting this Saturday. Plan your travel!

angles.name: Culture Celebration
angles.copy: From steel bands to incredible food, Notting Hill Carnival is a true celebration of Caribbean culture. Don't miss Europe's biggest street party this weekend!

moments.title: Premier League action continues today and tomorrow
moments.blurb: The Premier League's second matchday features three games today, including Newcastle v Liverpool, and Fulham v Chelsea tomorrow, after kicking off on Friday.

angles.name: Sunday Football Focus
angles.copy: Super Sunday in the Premier League! Newcastle host Liverpool, plus Brighton v Aston Villa and Man City v Bournemouth today. Who are you backing?

angles.name: Monday Night Football Preview
angles.copy: Wrap up the weekend with Monday Night Football! Fulham take on Chelsea in a West London derby. Can Xabi Alonso's new side get their first win?

angles.name: Newcastle Local Angle
angles.copy: It's a huge one at St James' Park today! Newcastle v Liverpool is live this afternoon. Can the Magpies get a big early season result?

moments.title: Championship weekend continues, Wrexham in action next week
moments.blurb: The EFL Championship has a Sunday fixture with West Brom v Burnley today, and Wrexham face Birmingham City next Friday.

angles.name: Championship Sunday
angles.copy: More Championship football today! West Bromwich Albion host Burnley. Who are you cheering for in the second tier?

angles.name: Wrexham Watch
angles.copy: The Red Dragons are back in action next Friday! Wrexham take on Birmingham City in the Championship. Will they continue their strong start?

angles.name: Welsh Teams Preview
angles.copy: Swansea City played yesterday, and Cardiff City are in action next weekend. How are our Welsh teams looking in the Championship this season?

moments.title: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean hold UK No.1, make chart history
moments.blurb: Sam Fender and Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' remains at UK No.1 for a record-breaking 22nd non-consecutive week, becoming the longest-running UK number-one single of all time.

angles.name: Chart Toppers
angles.copy: Still number one! Sam Fender & Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' has made history, now the longest-running UK No.1 single ever. What a track!

angles.name: Record Breakers
angles.copy: 22 weeks at the top! Sam Fender and Olivia Dean are officially chart legends. Have you streamed 'Rein Me In' today?

angles.name: New Music Alert
angles.copy: While 'Rein Me In' holds strong, keep an eye on new entries from KATSEYE, Phoebe Bridgers, and Josh Baker who are all making moves on the chart!

moments.title: August Bank Holiday approaches for England, Wales, NI
moments.blurb: The Summer Bank Holiday in England, Wales, and Northern Ireland is on Monday, August 31st, marking the unofficial end of summer for many.

angles.name: Long Weekend Vibes
angles.copy: Hands up if you're looking forward to the August Bank Holiday! A long weekend is just what we need before summer officially winds down.

angles.name: Bank Holiday Plans
angles.copy: Three-day weekend incoming! What are your plans for the August Bank Holiday? Festivals, family time, or just chilling out?

angles.name: Local Bank Holiday
angles.copy: Devon, get ready for the Bank Holiday! How are you making the most of the long weekend here in Exeter and across the county?

moments.title: Florence Welch of Florence + The Machine turns 40
moments.blurb: Florence Welch, the iconic frontwoman of Florence + The Machine, celebrates her 40th birthday on Thursday, August 28th. She's also performing at Reading & Leeds this weekend!

angles.name: Happy 40th Florence
angles.copy: Happy 40th Birthday to the incredible Florence Welch! From 'Dog Days Are Over' to headlining festivals, her voice is truly iconic. What's your favourite Florence + The Machine track?

angles.name: Festival Star Birthday
angles.copy: Celebrating Florence Welch's 40th birthday this week, just before she takes to the stage at Reading & Leeds! Talk about a double celebration.

moments.title: Legendary Van Morrison turns 81
moments.blurb: Northern Irish music icon Van Morrison celebrates his 81st birthday on Monday, August 31st.

angles.name: Van The Man
angles.copy: Happy 81st Birthday to the one and only Van Morrison on Monday! What's your go-to track from 'Van the Man'?

angles.name: Timeless Tunes
angles.copy: From 'Brown Eyed Girl' to 'Moondance,' Van Morrison's music is timeless. Wishing a very Happy 81st to a legend this Bank Holiday Monday!

moments.title: Gloria Estefan celebrates 69th birthday
moments.blurb: The 'Queen of Latin Pop' Gloria Estefan turns 69 on Tuesday, September 1st.

angles.name: Conga Queen
angles.copy: Get On Your Feet and wish Gloria Estefan a very Happy 69th Birthday on Tuesday! What's your favourite Miami Sound Machine hit?

angles.name: 80s Pop Icon
angles.copy: Celebrating the incredible career of Gloria Estefan as she turns 69! Her music still makes us want to 'Conga!'

moments.title: Glastonbury Festival takes a fallow year in 2026
moments.blurb: Glastonbury Festival is taking its traditional 'fallow year' in 2026 to allow Worthy Farm and the local area to recover, with the next festival confirmed for June 2027.

angles.name: Glasto Pause
angles.copy: No Glastonbury this year! 2026 is a fallow year for the legendary festival, giving Worthy Farm a well-deserved rest. Already counting down to 2027!

angles.name: Festival Land Rest
angles.copy: Did you know? Glastonbury takes a fallow year every few years to let the land recover. So, while there's no Glasto in 2026, it's all part of keeping the magic alive for 2027!
